title: Devices
count: {count} of {limit, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}
hint: You can connect as many devices as you have slots. A device appears here when a VPN app refreshes the subscription. When every slot is taken, a new device gets no servers — remove one you no longer use here, or with /devices in the bot.
overLimitWarning: Devices over the limit get no servers. Remove one you no longer use or buy more slots below.
emptyBody: A device shows up here the first time a VPN app refreshes the subscription from your link.
unavailable: Could not load your devices. Check your connection and try again.

confirmBody.app: Within a few minutes the app on this device stops connecting. If the subscription is still in the app, its next refresh takes a place again — to free the place for good, delete the subscription in the app first, then remove the device here.
confirmBody.incyWithoutHwid: Within a few minutes INCY on this device stops connecting. INCY without HWID sending cannot take a place again: to connect it later, turn on HWID sending in INCY's subscription settings and refresh the subscription.
confirmBody.wireguard: The config stops working within a few minutes and is deleted for good, and its place in your limit is freed. To connect that device again, create a new config on the Connect tab.

hwidTip: INCY without HWID sending counts as one device however many phones use it, and a new install without it gets no servers at all. Turn on HWID sending in INCY's subscription settings and refresh the subscription — every device will then show up here on its own. If places run out, remove the old INCY entry here.
